verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships a built-in AI SRE agent that you can chat with online, call from Slack by tagging @betterstack, or reach from MS Teams. It investigates incidents across logs, metrics, traces and errors. It also answers natural-language requests for logs and charts, drafts automated post-mortems, opens GitHub pull requests with suggested fixes, and creates Linear tickets from AI suggestions. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the agent's capabilities and limits, and any independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is marketing-page claims).
